research_question: Does StateGate's exact-object validation/proof loop produce measurable mechanism-to-outcome value relative to competent GitHub-native controls and those controls plus a minimal snapshot?

stategate.review_binding: require_review_approval=true; minimum_approvals=1; reviewed_head_sha must equal validated head

authority_boundary: GitHub rules/operator only; StateGate emits a required check and proof, never merge authority or merge execution.
claim_boundary: Same-owner controlled mechanism-to-outcome evidence only; no independent adoption/dependency, market demand, external economic validation, universal transferability, or ecosystem-wide claim.
execution_prerequisites: Three disposable repositories with active native rules and no trial bypass
An already-authorized approving reviewer distinct from each PR author; no recruitment under issue #43
Read-only repository/PR data collection plus artifact-upload scope only; verify StateGate and artifact action identities; no code, PR, checks, or merge write scope.
